general_eligibility.criteria: 10+2 pass in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate marks (varies by program).
10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and minimum 50% aggregate marks; JEE Main/state entrance score or university entrance evaluation considered.
10+2 with Mathematics as a mandatory subject and minimum 50% aggregate marks.
10+2 (for integrated law) or a Bachelor's degree (for LLB) with minimum 45% aggregate marks; CLAT/ILSAT or equivalent law entrance considered.
Bachelor's/Master's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks, as per NCTE norms.
Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks; CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT/NMAT score preferred.
B.Tech/B.E in relevant discipline with minimum 55% aggregate marks; GATE score preferred.
LLB/BA-LLB/BBA-LLB degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
Relevant Master's degree with minimum 55% aggregate marks; valid UGC-NET/GATE/state SET or the university's own Research Aptitude Test.
Exact eligibility criteria may have minor variations by specialization; refer to the program-specific eligibility page on the official IU Dehradun website for precise figures.
